case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for the openness in explaining your costs. We value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both.

Two points need to be looked at first:

Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

In the spirit of partnership, we have prepared options. Each one offers faster payment, and they differ in when the new price starts, so you can choose what suits your foundry best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 127.69; new price valid from 2027-01-01; payment 14 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 128.17; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 14 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 127.49; new price valid from 2026-11-01; payment 14 days net.

We hope one of these works for you and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We acknowledge your points regarding the notice period and quality, and as a reliable partner, we accept the effective date of 1 January 2027 to honor our contract. We appreciate your offer of 14-day payment terms, which we have incorporated into our proposal. 

In light of these adjusted terms and your verified data, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €134.20 per unit. Alternatively, our current proposal stands at a price of €137.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €134.20 per unit. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your reply and for checking our points so carefully. We appreciate your fairness, and your readiness to honor the contract means a great deal to us as a fellow family company.

Our order history shows a steady picture:

Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

With this in mind, we have made a serious effort to find a fair solution for both our companies.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 128.26; new price valid from 2027-01-01; payment 14 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 127.97; new price valid from 2026-11-01; payment 14 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 128.98; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 14 days net.

We look forward to continuing our long cooperation.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We did not know that - a fair point. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to make a further step towards you. For our main offer, we can present a price of €136.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Beside this, we can offer a revised price of €133.50 per unit, valid from 1 January 2027 with 14 days net payment. It is a pleasure to serve your respected house, and we look forward to continuing our tradition together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Thank you for your further step and for your kind words. We truly value the years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies, and we have not forgotten your support in difficult times.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 128.68; new price valid from 2027-01-01; payment 14 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 128.32; new price valid from 2026-11-01; payment 14 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 129.58; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 14 days net.

Options A and C keep your preferred timing with prompt payment, and Option B brings the new price forward for you. We believe one of them is a fair solution for both of our houses.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
